items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: My wife's... ...lady friend, I'll say. ...was Gertrude Dix. She ran... The house was called a brass railing. It was right next... ...to Mr. Anderson's Annex Saloon. ...I went to wake over there for her. Miss Dix.

ctx.x: Well, there's several of them. There's three Mike Lala's. I know three Mike Lala's. Tell about Tom Anderson. Tell now, tell us about Tom Anderson. What's that for you? Well...

Mr. Tom Anderson sent for me. His... My wife's... ...lady friend, I'll say. ...was Gertrude Dix. She ran... The house was called a brass railing. It was right next... ...to Mr. Anderson's Annex Saloon. Mr. Anderson's Annex Saloon. And, uh... I went to wake over there for her. Miss Dix. Well, I played there... ...about... ...or around about... ...eight or nine months.
How old were you by then? About...
